conflict.description: This deck changed on disk. Automatic saving is paused to protect both versions.

slide.regeneratePrompt: Regenerate only presentation slide {{slideId}} using the confirmed outline and available evidence. Preserve its stable slide ID, update semantic blocks and speaker notes, then validate the DeckSpec.

outline.description: Review goal, audience, theme, and slide titles, then confirm the outline before generating full slide content.
outline.continuePrompt: The presentation outline and theme are confirmed. Please complete the semantic content, speaker notes, and media requirements, then validate the DeckSpec.
outline.title: Confirm outline before filling
outline.missingRequired: Set title, language, and theme before confirming the outline.
outline.warnGoalAudience: Goal or audience is empty. You can still confirm, but filling may be less accurate.
outline.confirmed: Outline confirmed. Content filling can begin.
outline.exportBlocked: Confirm the outline before exporting PPTX.
outline.themeRemapReport: Theme remapped {{from}} → {{to}}. {{count}} slide(s) may need a layout remap — check candidates chips.

media.assetIdRequired: This image block needs an asset ID before media can be imported.
media.importOutdated: The image was imported, but its media slot changed before the DeckSpec could be updated.
media.generatePrompt: Generate an image for presentation slide {{slideId}}, block {{blockId}}, asset {{assetId}}, using the configured custom image model. Save it in this deck's assets directory and update only that asset slot; preserve the previous image if generation fails.
media.pendingHint: Importe, gere ou ignore este espaço reservado para não bloquear a exportação.
media.errorHint: Importe um substituto, gere novamente ou ignore este slot.
media.readyStatus: Imagem pronta — importe ou gere para substituir.

error.invalidSpec: This file is not a valid WorkMate DeckSpec v1.
error.catalogUnavailable: The built-in presentation catalog is unavailable.
